headline: Expat son brings mother to village by helicopter to fulfill a dream
summary: An expat son fulfilled his mother's long-cherished dream by bringing her to their ancestral village in a helicopter. The emotional journey marked a special return home for the family.
details: An expat son, after years of hard work abroad, fulfilled his mother's dream of returning to their village by helicopter. This unique gesture created a memorable moment for the family and the local community.
The mother, accompanied by her son, arrived in the village to a warm reception, adorned with garlands and flowers. The event was a testament to the son's dedication and love for his mother.

This act highlights the deep emotional bonds within Bangladeshi families and the aspirations of many expatriates to provide comfort and joy to their parents. It symbolizes the success and gratitude of a son towards his mother.

headline: Ronaldo to decide on retirement after family discussions, says star player
summary: Cristiano Ronaldo has indicated he will consult with his family before making a final decision on his potential retirement from professional football.
details: Football legend Cristiano Ronaldo has indicated that he will make an 'appropriate decision' regarding his future in professional football, including the prospect of retirement.
He clarified that this significant personal and career choice would be made following discussions with his family members.
